Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

betterbiplot 2.0.0

Package Conversion

  • Converted the standalone r/better_biplot.r script into the betterbiplot R package with proper DESCRIPTION, NAMESPACE, roxygen2 documentation (?bb_biplot), and testthat unit tests.
  • Retained a stub r/better_biplot.r (excluded from package builds via .Rbuildignore) that prints a migration notice when source()d directly from GitHub.
  • Updated README.md with package installation instructions (remotes::install_github("benbell95/better_biplot")) and fixed minor argument typos (group3, f1.a).

New Features

  • Added S3 methods for additional PCA objects without adding hard dependencies:

    • bb_biplot.rda() for unconstrained vegan::rda() PCA models (converted to base R scale for full compatibility with prcomp() / biplot()).
    • bb_biplot.svyprcomp() for survey::svyprcomp() objects, supporting group3 = "scaled" to scale point sizes by survey weights (sqrt(w / max(w))).
    • bb_biplot.PCA() for FactoMineR::PCA() objects.
    • bb_biplot.pca() for ade4::dudi.pca() objects.
    • bb_biplot.principal() for psych::principal() objects.

  • Added selective group legends: legend now accepts TRUE / "all" (all supplied groups) or integer values in 1:3 (e.g. 1, c(1, 3), 3) to display only selected group legends, with positional or group-indexed title.leg matching.

  • Condensed group3 legends to always show minimum, middle, and maximum symbol sizes (with y.intersp = 1.25), and wired survey::svyprcomp(..., group3 = "scaled") to also display a condensed min/median/max weight legend when legends are enabled.

  • Streamlined bb_biplot() arguments by grouping fine-grained styling into lab.args, var.args, ellipse.args (also accepted via alias chull.args), and leg.args, and combining pc1/pc2 into pc = c(1, 2) (while keeping title.leg and circle.eq top-level).

  • Added a soft deprecation shim for all v1.x flat argument names (pc1, pc2, col.v, whichv, expand, lab_rotation, angle, se, cex.leg, lpx, f1.a, etc.) so existing scripts continue to run with deprecation warnings.

  • Replaced the v1.x parametric ellipse approximation (angle, se) with statistical covariance confidence ellipses (ellipse.args = list(method = "cov", level = 0.95), default) and small-sample Hotelling’s T-squared ellipses (method = "t").

  • Added group centroids (centroids = TRUE, "points", or "labels") and radial spider lines (spider = TRUE).

  • Added var.args = list(lab.offset = 1.05) to nudge variable labels past arrow tips.

  • Added palette name shorthand in col (any grDevices::palette.pals() or grDevices::hcl.pals() palette, e.g. col = "Okabe-Ito" or "Viridis").

  • Added configurable point opacity (alpha = 0.85) and hull/ellipse opacity (ellipse.args = list(alpha = 0.25, border.alpha = 0.9)).

  • Made unrotated observation label placement deterministic by default (lab.args = list(pos = "auto"), also supporting "random" or 1:4).

  • bb_biplot() now invisibly returns a "bb_biplot" object (scores, loadings, lim, limr, pc, pvar, group_cols, centroids) for downstream base R annotations.

  • Added varimax.args (normalize = TRUE, eps = 1e-5) to customise stats::varimax() when varimax.rotate = TRUE.

  • Added package vignette vignette("betterbiplot") with rendered examples across scaling, grouping, overlays, legends, vegan::rda(), survey::svyprcomp(), and post-plot extensions.

Bug Fixes

  • Automatic xlab/ylab generation: Stopped forwarding ... into paste0() (which caused errors when graphical parameters such as main were passed) and handled missing/NULL xsd cleanly instead of producing empty labels.
  • whichv with lab_rotation = TRUE: Subsetted variable rotation angles (lvsrt) alongside y so subsetted variable labels receive their own rotation angles instead of the first rows’ angles.
  • whichv = "circle.eq":
    • Explicitly required circle.eq = TRUE instead of leaving match unassigned (which previously collided with base::match).
    • Checked the 2D vector radius sqrt((y[, 1] * expand)^2 + (y[, 2] * expand)^2) > cr instead of only abs(y[, 2]) > cr, keeping whichv = "circle.eq" consistent when expand != 1.
  • Single-variable whichv subsetting: Used y[vmatch, , drop = FALSE] to preserve the 2-column matrix structure cleanly.
  • Rotated observation labels: Fixed adj = c(lsrt[i, 2], lsrt[i, 3]) (previously passed column 2 twice, ignoring valign and ran_adj vertical alignment).
  • f1 and f2 callbacks: Replaced as.list(args(f1)) with list() when f1.a/f2.a are omitted, fixing crashes when calling functions that accept ... (such as graphics::grid()).
  • group2 symbol assignment: Avoided expanding default pch for group before checking group2, ensuring distinct symbols are generated for group2 even when nlevels(group) >= nlevels(group2). Added length/group validation for group2 and group3.
  • Single-level group legends: Handled nlevels(group) == 1 when computing vertical legend spacing so subsequent group2/group3 legends do not receive NA y-coordinates.
  • Ellipses and convex hulls edge cases: Handled unused factor levels and constant-x groups cleanly in ellipses and convex hulls.
  • Label rotation edge cases: Avoided NaN angles at (0, 0) and applied left-side text justification (ad1 = 1) for all x < 0 (including the negative x-axis where y == 0).
  • Modern R checks & namespace hygiene: Replaced class(x) == ... / class(x) != ... with is.factor() / is.character(), avoided shadowing base::c() and base::match(), and explicitly imported all non-base functions (graphics, grDevices, methods, stats).
